detail.overview:
Welcome to the 2026 Kaggle Playground Series! We plan to continue in the spirit of previous playgrounds, providing interesting and approachable datasets for our community to practice their machine learning skills, and anticipate a competition each month.

Your Goal: Predicting credit card fraud.
detail.evaluation:
Submissions are evaluated on area under the ROC curve between the predicted probability and the observed target.

Submission File
For each id in the test set, you must predict a probability for the is_fraud. The file should contain a header and have the following format:

 id,is_fraud
 699960,0.3
 699961,0.9
 699962,0.2
 etc.
detail.data_or_tools:
The dataset for this competition (both train and test) was inspired by the Credit Card Fraud Detection 2026
. Feature distributions are close to, but not exactly the same, as the original. 

Files

* train.csv - the training set, with is_fraud as target
* test.csv - the test set, used to predict the probability for is_fraud
* sample_submission.csv - a sample submission file in the correct format

detail.team:
a. The maximum Team size is three (3).

b. Team mergers are allowed and can be performed by the Team leader. In order to merge, the combined Team must have a total Submission count less than or equal to the maximum allowed as of the Team Merger Deadline. The maximum allowed is the number of Submissions per day multiplied by the number of days the competition has been running.
